fusions.name: Falling Portcullis
fusions.desc: Brings 4 lashes down side by side out to 5 tiles; each deals 8 damage and drives its target back 2 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing Loop
fusions.desc: Casts a loop at the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Ringmaster's Hush
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash once and holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: The Tamer's Side
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
